approach: Static recompilation of the retail XBE to C. The title's own D3D8LTCG writes an NV2A pushbuffer, which the runtime executes: vertex programs and register combiners are translated to HLSL and drawn on Direct3D 11, with a software rasteriser as the per-batch fallback.
help: PAL 50 Hz boot path (the runtime forces NTSC-M even for a PAL disc)
MCPX DSP (GP/EP) emulation, today a stub
Audio for the FMV player, which decodes video only
Telling a guest VA from a physical offset in the memory map
notes: Boots, renders on the GPU at a paced 60 fps, enumerates two pads, and plays music and effects. Not playable yet: it hangs on the profile-creation screen, so a save cannot be created. Everything claimed here is measured and the numbers are in docs/findings/. English here because this file feeds a public index; the rest of the repository is in Portuguese.
